# dtcloud_router_static_routes (Data Source)

Lists the static routes on a router, including any added outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every route on the router, including any added outside Terraform.
data "dtcloud_router_static_routes" "edge" {
  router_id = dtcloud_router.main.id
}

output "routes" {
  value = {
    for r in data.dtcloud_router_static_routes.edge.routes :
    r.destination => r.next_hop
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (String) ID of the router whose static routes are listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `routes` (List of Object) The router's static routes, in the order the platform holds them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `destination` (String)
- `next_hop` (String)

## Behaviour worth knowing

* **The endpoint reports the two fields under different names** from the ones used everywhere else
  in the provider. They are given back here under the names `dtcloud_router_static_route` uses, so
  the same route is called the same thing throughout.
* **Routes added outside Terraform are listed too**, which is what this data source is for.
